feature_contract.goal: Preserve the entire GOAL progress 0–99% source's original animated digits and title as a single binocular HUD graphic by carrying exact producer ownership through direct D3DX deferred GPU submission and queued SpriteNode presentation, while preserving other GOAL clocks and result screens.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only exact original ResultProgress E8 producer and homogeneous native D3DXSprite batches carrying its own ScreenHud source. Do not globally flush D3DX or retag mixed buffers, mutate game timer/results, steal SpriteNode queue scopes, change lens or SkyGlow or touch DX11/DXVK.
trace_stages: Original GOAL animation parent 0x2D200 and its 0x97BE4/0x97DEC hooks synchronously create direct digits alongside appended SpriteNodes; ResultProgressEnter and Leave bracket the native producer.

FlushD3DXBeforeDirectGoalSource splits an outgoing proven direct batch before the producer scope, and FlushD3DXAtDirectGoalSourceExit submits the owned homogeneous result-progress batch before scoped producer restoration; TagAppendedNodes handles deferred nodes separately.

Effective ScreenHud source follows c64/D3DX/fixed-function draw semantics into the R84 R33→R32→R31→R30→R29 left/right stereo path and x64 OpenXR host, with exact Quest3/VDXR eye verification still required.
subcomponents: Guard the full exact GOAL 0–99% parent E8 with a direct ScreenHud ResultProgress owner while retaining nested depth and queue-first precedence.

Split earlier direct D3DX contents before acquiring the progress owner, then flush only an exact, homogeneous progress batch before that owner is released; preserve native behavior for unknown and mixed buffers.
Keep post-call per-priority appended node tags and add C++ predicate allow/deny compile assertions and destructive regression mutations for both pre- and post-flush owner gates.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Before 3b36a6b38ef05373301ce00d296ed8fb69d26b09, the exact ResultProgress parent tagged appended queue nodes but a direct D3DXSprite Draw could remain buffered beyond the producer exit and lose its original semantic at actual GPU submission.
diagnosis.root_cause: The native D3DX sprite batch GPU lifetime outlived the GOAL progress E8 scope. Its inherited c64/ScreenHud identity could be wrong even when the parent and queued children were correctly tagged.
source_trace: src/hooks_uiscaling.cpp exact ResultProgressEnter/Leave around original 0x2D200 parent and its synchronous 0x97BE4/0x97DEC output.
src/hooks_uiscaling.cpp direct D3DX isolation helper flushes proven old batch before owner acquisition and exact current progress batch before owner release, preserving native queue path.

src/vr/game/render_semantics.hpp CanFlushD3DXDirectGoalAtExit admits only exact original GOAL time or ResultProgress matching producer and homogeneous ScreenHud, consumed by the R84 draw and eye path.
alternatives_rejected: Global D3DXSprite Flush, unconditional ScreenHud tagging, and changing original GOAL/timer state would risk unrelated visual effects and unknown native buffers.
Repeating previous +TIME/GOAL helper hooks does not protect the separate animated ResultProgress GPU lifetime.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material commit 3b36a6b38ef05373301ce00d296ed8fb69d26b09 adds exact pre-owner split and post-owner direct GPU flush around ResultProgress, extends strict producer admission and verifies missing/reordered admission with targeted source mutations.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Source includes constexpr rejection of mixed, foreign, queue-owned and producer-mismatched batch cases plus source-negative mutations. First Active run 38713028962 failed in policy only because this required run record was absent; no Windows game/host/package stages executed.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R84 original game semantic ScreenHud is consumed by the existing R30 classifier and R33-owned two physical eye Draws, then x64 OpenXR host; hardware outcome is not inferred from source inspection.
diagnosis.evidence_limits: Exact original callsite and scope are statically confirmed; no evidence yet that the observed 0–99% duplicate disappears in the user's Quest3, and Windows exact-SHA full gate is pending.

runtime_evidence: No Windows game or Quest3/VDXR headset visual test was performed for this retry.
